Every day I try to make a few patches and fix the game, but this time it's the biggest fix, so I'm posting it here.

notes.title: Update 0.6.2: Investment Improvements
notes.notes:
- A new difficulty parameter called "Luck" has been added — if things feel too easy, try again on realistic difficulty and forget about lotteries, expensive gifts from friends, and other freebies.
- Investment projects can now be improved using your contacts — up to three of them will offer suggestions on how to make the project better.
- Investment projects can now come from companies listed on the stock market — the outcome will affect their share price and income.
- Investment projects are now tied to a specific business sector — their results may influence the entire sector.
- Company sectors have been revised — there are now 8 instead of 11 (some were merged).
- If you have an old save file (before version 6.1), you can now optionally create your profile and choose a name, appearance, birthday, and biography elements (though not all perks will be available).
- Companies can now perform stock splits — if the share price becomes too low or too high, they may multiply or divide all shares. The value of one share changes, but the total value does not.
- There’s now a 33% chance that instead of going bankrupt, a company will do a stock split to stay listed longer.
- The average share purchase price is now calculated more accurately (using the moving average method).
- When selling stocks, you’ll now pay tax only on the profit — the difference between your average purchase price and the selling price.
- Car accidents now happen slightly less often.
- Fires will also occur a bit less frequently.
- The Financial Services Agency now does its job a little better.
- The "Fortune Teller" biography now has a slightly lower chance of predicting a bad future.
- Some buttons now support hotkeys.
- Updated Chinese translation by Stevezxc.
- Fixed a bug that miscalculated the income required for the "Successful Leader" milestone.
- Fixed a bunch of minor bugs.

notes.title: Small patch

notes.title: New Major Update 0.6
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8MI1FaN78Ug;full][/previewyoutube]

This update brings a lot of new features and improvements as I continue moving the game closer to full release. Here's what's new:
Character Creation SystemYou can now create your character at the start: set your name, birthday, appearance, and choose up to three biography elements.Biography elements work as perks, giving bonuses or penalties during the game. Some become available only after unlocking certain milestones.CEO Mode is now one of the biography options, unlocked after successfully creating your own company at least once.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/435f92c8c5f965ea1dac58ee5de510a7bfa0890e.png
New Investment OptionsAdded trading in gold, silver, oil, and metals.Commodities are more stable than stocks, making them ideal for long-term wealth storage.New news events related to commodity prices.New news events related to yen currency fluctuations.Expanded Real Estate SystemProperties are now divided into districts, which affect their prices.Commercial real estate added — more expensive but offering greater profits.You can now sort properties by district and buy all available properties with one click.New City ActivitiesPlayers who own a car can now drive to the city center for weekend relaxation.Horse racetrack added to the city map as a new leisure location.Takeover System ChangesIf you already hold a majority stake in a company, it cannot refuse your buyout offer.Larger stakes increase your chances of a successful acquisition.Other ImprovementsIt is now easier to place larger bets at the horse racetrack.Unemployed friends are now available during weekdays.Improved gamepad controls.Added new milestones.Bug FixesFixed winner calculation in Poker.Fixed the company management menu not opening with the "7" key.Fixed a bug where short selling required more reputation than displayed.Fixed news events appearing for companies not listed on the exchange.Corrected the display of the autumn equinox (previously shown in spring).Balance AdjustmentsNew companies now appear more frequently.Company profits now have a stronger effect on stock prices.Companies grow less frequently into unrealistically massive corporations.Added a new event where large unprofitable companies are forced to lay off employees and downsize over time.
As you can see, the promised commercial real estate feature has been implemented earlier than planned.
During development, priorities shifted slightly, so I will soon publish an updated roadmap and a separate post about it.
In short: the game is getting close to full release.
I plan one more major update during summer, after which I will start preparing for the full release with Story Mode.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: STONKS-9800: Update 0.5
notes.notes:
Finally fixed a claw machine!

New Features:


 New Mini-Game: "UFO Cosmic Claw" – a claw machine arcade game where you can collect various items.
 Item Gifting: Send collected items to your friends via mail.
 Calendar System: Keep track of shareholder meetings, holidays, and planned events, including court hearings.
 New Random Event: Companies can forecast their revenue to impress investors.
 Additional Random Events: A few more surprises to keep things interesting.
 Investment Center: Build an investment center to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
 Bar Gossip: Friends in the bar occasionally share rumors about various companies.
 Temple Donations: You can now choose the size of your donation at the temple.
 Reputation Perks: Reputation levels now grant new advantages, detailed in the "Profile" tab. These include (but are not limited to):
 High public reputation increases the chance of being invited to spend time with directors and board members.
 Speeches by highly reputable players have a stronger impact on the company.
 The ethics level affects the speed of friendship growth with Amy.
 Temple donations can reduce stress and boost happiness.
 Friendships won't drop below a certain level if you have a high networking stat.
 High networking helps you make friends faster.
 High market reputation lets you buy more shares during IPOs and on the stock exchange, and reduces stock purchase fees.
 Bank terms are now clearly displayed based on your financial reputation level.


Improvements:


 Gamepad Support: Hoshisama is now controllable with the gamepad stick.
 Popup Navigation: Interacting with buttons in popups is now easier using a gamepad.
 Expense Tracking: Hover over your total funds at the top of the screen to see recent expenses and income in all menus.
 Balance Visibility: Easily identify which transactions affect your balance.


Balance Adjustments:


 Yakuza services are now cheaper.
 Achievements now grant slightly fewer reputation points.



Other Enhancements:


 Text Display: Certain parts of messages are now highlighted with different colors for better readability. Text appears in a more user-friendly manner.
 Home Screen Updates: Slight rearrangement of elements. Chibi Amy now reminds you about holidays and upcoming events.
 Improved Animations: Popup animations have been refined for a smoother experience.
 Holiday Greetings: Amy will now personally greet you on all holidays.
 Sound Effects: Added sound effects for character dialogues and for spending or earning money.


Fixes:


 Fixed overlapping sounds when casting the fishing rod during fishing.
 Fixing all sorts of small bugs

notes.title: Small update 0.4.3.8
STONKS-9800 Update 0.4.3: Fishing, Poker and more!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=hAbeWs-SioM;full][/previewyoutube]

New:


 New Mini-Game: Fishing on Vacation
 New Mini-Game: Secret Poker (Texas Hold'em)
 Direct dealings with the Yakuza: you can order them to take out rivals, shake up certain financial sectors, and even buy your way out of their wrath at any moment.
 New Vacation Outfit for Amy
 You can change the color palette of the interface, with additional color sets and the option to create custom palettes by editing the file "data/palette.png"


Quality of life:


 You can now adjust the daily expense size by clicking directly on the scale, not just the + or - buttons.
 The right mouse button now functions as Escape in most menus (making it more convenient to play one-handed).
 News about changes in high-ranking positions will now display the portrait and information of the individuals.
 Stock price charts now show more consistent numerical values.
 You can now navigate the "Advisor" tab and "Milestones" menu using arrow keys on the keyboard or gamepad, and the Escape button returns to the previous screen.

These changes are part of my gradual effort to make the game fully operable using only the keyboard (which will also improve gamepad controls) as well as only the mouse.


Fixes and Other:


 Added crash notification system: if the game crashes, you will be prompted to send me a report (currently works only on Windows).
 You can no longer purchase real estate or cars while on vacation.
 You can no longer buy suspicious companies.
 Fixed a bug where a new company going public (IPO) had incorrect data from another bankrupt company (e.g., you were already in debt with short stocks).
 Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when exiting to the main menu.
 Fixed a bug where characters had two first names instead of a first name and a last name.
 Fixed an issue where you could start the next day during the Board of Directors meeting by pressing Enter.
 Fixed a bug where the name of an illegal company could repeat.
 Fixed a bug where the player could instantly lose the CEO position after engaging in illegal business.
 Amy no longer leaves with each new dialogue line.
 Players who have been waiting a long time for company responses can finally send new purchase offers (after some time).

Important Announcement Regarding the 0.3 Game Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Apologies are in order. It looks like I bit off more than I could chew this time around. Who knew that rest isn’t just a suggestion, but a necessity? Shocking, right?

So here’s the deal: I dropped the ball and patch 0.3 is going to need a bit more TLC before it’s ready to roll out. But don’t worry, I’ll be sharing more screenshots in the next few days – so keep your eyes on Twitter and Discord.

Now, for a quick refresher: this patch is all about breathing life into your entrepreneurial spirit. You’ll get to build your company from the ground up, handpick your team, assign roles, and watch your empire expand. And for those of you who are as impatient as I am, you can jump straight into the action with a ready-to-go company (it’ll be a modest start, but hey, Rome wasn’t built in a day).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/75ed96655f428facec491da0d01c46de653f296f.jpg

I can't thank you enough for your patience and understanding. I’m considering a tweak in the roadmap to ensure I deliver nothing but top-notch updates without the delay. Every promise made will be a promise kept, that’s a guarantee.

Catch you soon!
